description: Labeled Agent reasoning excerpts and Codex status titles for the thought summarizer's housekeeping check (ADR 0036). `expected` is `skip` when the input is only the Agent's own process — reading its memory, notes, manual, instructions, or skills; checking its inbox or messages; claiming or updating tasks; deciding whether to reply; reading prior conversation just to orient; composing, drafting, or double-checking its own reply in the Chat — and `show` when it describes work on the person's request, including mixed inputs that mention housekeeping alongside that work. Optional `rules` add wording checks for a shown phrase: `banned` words or phrases it must not contain, and `mentionsAny` words of which it must contain at least one. Every shown phrase is also checked for the "right now" and trailing "now" filler, length, and the run's share of lines that open with "I".
